blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The 41st day of Vice President Sara Duterte’s impeachment trial on Tuesday centered on the credibility of the defense’s witnesses, as Davao City accountant Vingelin Bajan admitted under prosecution cross-examination that she was only a “partner in name” at the Ampil, Elises, Ciudadano and Co. CPAs accounting firm linked to companies tied to Duterte and her spouse, lawyer Manases Carpio. Bajan was presented by the defense to rebut the prosecution’s allegation that Duterte received compensation from the Davao City government in 2023 while already serving as vice president.
